key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:81D0
name: call_dos_if_flag_clear
description: Checks a flag byte in the global data block and, only when it is zero, calls a DOS library function through the library base. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:81EE
name: call_dos_if_flag_clear
description: Behaves like its neighbour: when the flag byte in the global data block is zero it calls the DOS library function, and otherwise it returns without action.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:820C
name: read_dos_data_block
description: Calls a helper, then a DOS Read through the library base, then the helper again, with an extra helper call on each side when a flag byte is set. The code sets no return value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8250
name: match_input_char_in_set
description: Reads characters through a helper and passes each one to a second helper, folding lowercase letters to uppercase where the class table marks them. It returns the first character that appears in the argument string, repeating until one matches.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8296
name: read_input_until_match
description: Reads input characters through a helper and passes each to a second helper, stepping through the argument string until the typed character equals the current string byte. It returns that matched character.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:82B2
name: advance_input_match_pointer
description: Advances the string pointer by one, then reads input characters through a helper until the typed character equals the current string byte. It returns the matched character.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:82B6
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:82BC
name: call_helper_between_globals
description: Calls a helper with the global data block as its argument, then calls a no-argument helper, then calls the first helper again. It performs no computation of its own.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:82D4
name: compute_visible_text_rows
description: Opens intuition.library, takes the active window's height less the screen's top area, and divides it by the screen font's line height to get the visible row count, with a minimum of 8. It returns 23 when any lookup fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:838C
name: check_for_wildcard_chars
description: Copies an eight-byte set of wildcard and punctuation characters from the global data block, then returns 1 if the argument string contains any of them and 0 otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:83C2
name: match_string_char_in_set
description: Checks each character of the argument string against an eight-entry set kept in the caller's stack frame, returning 1 at the first match and 0 at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:83C6
name: test_next_char_in_set
description: Same test as its neighbour, but the string pointer is advanced before each comparison: it returns 1 when a character matches the stack-held set and 0 at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:83CA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8A80
name: allocate_memory_via_exec
description: Calls the exec library's memory allocation function through the exec library base, leaving the result for the caller.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8AC2
name: free_memory_via_exec
description: Calls the exec library's memory release function through the exec library base to free a block; the caller supplies the argument registers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8AE0
name: allocate_buffer_halving_size
description: Tries to allocate a block of the requested size, halving the size after each failure while it stays above 256. It stores the block address and returns 0 on success, or reports failure through a helper and returns 1.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8B00
name: retry_allocation_halving_size
description: Halves the size held in the stored cell before each attempt and stops once it reaches 256 or below. On success it stores the pointer and returns 0; otherwise it reports the insufficient-memory fatal error through a helper and returns 1.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8B24
name: forward_arguments_to_helper
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to a second helper and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8B40
name: consume_bits_and_refill
description: Subtracts a bit count from the bit reader's counter and shifts the bit buffer right by that count. When the counter goes negative, it loads the next 16-bit word from the input stream into the buffer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8BCA
name: read_bits_before_consume
description: Saves the current bit buffer, consumes the requested number of bits through the bit reader helper, and returns the low bits of the saved buffer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8BF8
name: decode_main_tree_symbol
description: Decodes one symbol from the main Huffman tree by indexing with the low eight bits of the bit buffer and walking the tree bit by bit for longer codes. It passes a byte from a per-symbol table to a helper and returns the symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8C56
name: decode_six_bit_tree_symbol
description: Decodes one symbol using a six-bit lookup table, walking the tree bit by bit for longer codes. It passes a byte from a fixed table in the decoder state to a helper and returns the symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8CB0
name: reset_bit_buffer_from_stream
description: Reads two 16-bit words from the input stream, advances the stream pointer past them, sets the bit counter to 16 and loads the bit buffer with the two words.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8CFE
name: read_256_raw_bytes
description: Reads 256 bytes one at a time through a helper and stores them consecutively at the address given as argument. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8D2E
name: read_block_and_checksum
description: Reads a run of bytes through a helper into the caller's buffer, one more than the count argument, and returns the 16-bit sum of the bytes read.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8D60
name: read_lzx_block_header_tables
description: Reads the header of an LZX block, including bit fields that give buffer and table sizes, then allocates the block buffer and reports an insufficient-memory error when that fails. For one block type it also sums the stored bytes and loops forever if the sum does not match the stored checksum.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8F3A
name: count_newlines_in_string
description: Walks a null-terminated string and returns the number of newline characters in it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8F5C
name: call_helper_with_arg_one
description: Calls a helper with the argument one and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8F68
name: print_text_wrapped_to_width
description: Writes a text block one line at a time, breaking lines at newline characters and at a width obtained from a helper. A status check from a helper stops output early, and the remaining width is recalculated after each wrapped line.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:8FF0
name: fold_four_bytes_to_word
description: Folds four bytes starting at the argument address into one 16-bit value, shifting the running value left by four bits before adding each byte. It returns that value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9016
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:901E
name: set_init_flag_and_call
description: If the flag byte in the decoder state is zero, sets it to one and calls a helper with argument zero; otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9084
name: compare_path_file_names
description: Finds the file name after the last slash or colon in each of two paths and compares the two names with a string helper. It returns 1 when the names match and 0 otherwise, including when the first path is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:90BC
name: match_path_basename_via_helper
description: Finds the file name after the last slash or colon in the current path and calls a helper on it. It returns 1 when that helper returns zero, and 0 for an empty path.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:90E8
name: test_helper_result_zero
description: Calls a helper and returns true when its result is zero, false otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:90FA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9102
name: check_path_ends_with_slash
description: Returns 1 when the last character of the argument string is a forward slash, and 0 when it is not or the string is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9126
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9250
name: normalize_path_separators
description: Walks a null-terminated path and replaces every backslash with a forward slash in place, leaving other characters unchanged.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:926E
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9274
name: split_path_into_parts
description: Splits a path into a volume or device prefix before a colon, a directory part before the last slash, and a file name, writing each into the supplied buffers when they are present. It returns a status value from the split.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:92CA
name: copy_path_name_part
description: Copies the file name portion of a path into the output buffer, or the whole string when no separator was found. When a slash ends the leading part, it also stores the preceding directory part through a helper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:92E2
name: copy_path_name_after_index
description: Copies the file name that follows a known split index into the output buffer. When the split character is a slash, it searches back for a colon and stores the directory or volume part through a helper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9312
name: terminate_split_path_parts
description: Writes terminating null bytes at the ends of the directory and volume buffers, positioned from the split index, when the path contains a slash.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:933E
name: terminate_split_path_tail
description: Writes a terminating null into the directory buffer, and when a colon sits at the split position, into the volume buffer as well.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9400
name: find_matching_list_node
description: Walks a linked list of named entries and returns the first entry whose name equals the argument string. Depending on the flag bits it compares the whole name, or runs a helper test and, when that passes, makes two DOS library calls and returns the entry if the second result is nonzero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9424
name: find_list_node_from_state
description: Walks the same kind of named list using the flag bit from the caller's registers and the stack-held name buffers, returning the first matching entry or null. It applies the same name comparison and DOS library check as its neighbour.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:942E
name: find_list_node_by_helper
description: Walks a linked list of entries and returns the first one that passes a name test, with a DOS library check when a flag is set. It returns null when no entry passes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:94A6
name: find_next_list_match
description: Tests the current list entry and, if it fails, steps through the list to the next entry that passes the same name test. It returns null when the end of the list is reached.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:94BC
name: step_list_until_name_match
description: Makes two DOS library calls at the top of each step and returns the current entry if the second result is nonzero. It then steps forward through the list to the next entry that passes the name test.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:94EA
name: advance_list_name_match
description: Steps forward through the entries, testing each name with a helper, and returns the first entry that passes or null at the end of the list. A DOS library check can end the walk early.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:94F2
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9590
name: add_named_list_entry_checked
description: Creates a list entry holding a copy of the name, allocating its memory through a helper and zeroing its header, then appends it to the tail. When the flag is set it first rejects an existing name with status 2, and an allocation failure sets status 1 and returns null.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:95D4
name: add_unique_named_list_entry
description: Appends a named entry to the list only when no entry with that name already exists, returning null with status 2 otherwise. An allocation failure sets status 1 and also returns null.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:95DE
name: append_named_list_entry
description: Allocates an entry sized for the name, copies the name in, and appends the entry to the list tail without checking for duplicates. An allocation failure sets the status to 1 and returns null.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:9606
name: initialize_and_append_entry
description: Initializes an already-allocated list entry by clearing its header, copying the name in, and appending it to the list tail. It does not allocate.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:963A
name: append_entry_or_report_error
description: Appends an entry to the list when the tail pointer is set. Otherwise it reports the internal list error through a helper, sets status 1 and returns null.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:966C
name: link_entry_to_list_tail
description: Links an entry onto the list tail and sets the status to zero. It performs no checks, so the tail pointer must already be valid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B2A0
name: open_lzx_output_file
description: Opens the output file named in the decoder state through a helper, and when that succeeds passes the name to a second helper. It returns true on success and false otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B324
name: close_output_handle_if_set
description: If the handle stored at a fixed offset in the decoder state is nonzero, passes it to a helper to release it. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B524
name: allocate_all_lzx_buffers
description: Allocates every LZX decoder buffer in sequence, starting with the block buffer sized from the decoder state, then the windows, tables and table setup. A failed allocation is reported through a helper and returns 1; success sets the window pointers and returns 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B544
name: allocate_lzx_buffers_from_window
description: Allocates the decoder buffers from the first 131072-byte window onward, then sets the window pointers and the table setup. A failed allocation is reported through a helper and returns 1, otherwise 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B560
name: allocate_lzx_second_window_buffers
description: Allocates the decoder buffers from the second 131072-byte window onward, then completes the table setup. A failed allocation is reported through a helper and returns 1, otherwise 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B57C
name: allocate_lzx_buffers_from_block
description: Allocates the decoder buffers starting from the block buffer sized by the decoder state, followed by the table and window buffers. A failed allocation is reported through a helper and returns 1; success returns 0 after the table setup.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B59E
name: allocate_lzx_first_table_buffers
description: Allocates the 32768-byte table buffers starting with the first, then the remaining buffers and the table setup. A failed allocation is reported through a helper and returns 1, otherwise 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B5BE
name: allocate_lzx_second_table_buffers
description: Allocates the buffers starting from a second 32768-byte table, then the remaining buffers, the table setup and the window pointers. A failed allocation is reported through a helper and returns 1, otherwise 0.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B5D8
name: allocate_lzx_aligned_table_buffers
description: Allocates a 4096-byte buffer, then runs the table setup, returning 1 after a reported failure and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B5F0
name: init_lzx_tables_and_finish
description: Runs a table helper, and on success sets the window pointers, calls two helpers and sets the ready flag, returning false. When the table helper reports failure, it calls a helper and returns true.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B60A
name: finish_lzx_buffer_setup
description: Sets the window pointers from the decoder buffers, calls two helpers and marks the decoder as ready, then returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B638
name: free_all_lzx_buffers
description: Frees each decoder buffer whose pointer is set, using the size recorded for each one, and clears its pointer. It then resets the table state through a helper.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B762
name: free_optional_lzx_buffer
description: Frees the buffer stored at a fixed offset in the decoder state when its pointer is set, using the size held in the state, and clears the pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B77A
name: flush_pending_lzx_output
description: Writes the bytes between the start pointer and the end pointer through a helper, and when that write succeeds calls a second helper with the value seven. It then moves the start pointer up to the end.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B89E
name: read_lzx_input_bytes_checked
description: Reads the requested number of bytes into the input buffer through a helper and adds the count to the running total when all of them arrive. It returns 1 without reading when the end-of-data flag and a helper check both indicate the input is finished, 2 on a short read, and 0 otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B8A4
name: call_state_block_helper_one
description: Calls a helper with the decoder state block at a fixed offset and the value one, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B8B4
name: allocate_lzx_input_state_block
description: Allocates a 7728-byte input state block through a helper, and on success points three decoder state fields into the block at fixed offsets. It returns true when the allocation failed.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B8CA
name: reset_lzx_input_state_pointers
description: Points three decoder state fields at offsets inside the already-allocated input state block, then returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:B8E6
name: free_lzx_input_state_block
description: If the input state block pointer is set, frees the 7728-byte block through a helper and clears the pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:BCAC
name: build_doubling_run_table
description: Fills a 512-entry byte table in the decoder state, starting with entries zero to three and then writing runs whose length doubles each time. It runs only once, guarded by a flag in the decoder state.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:BCF4
name: continue_doubling_run_table
description: Continues the doubling-run fill of the same 512-entry table from its current index, writing one run per pass until the table end is reached.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:BD14
name: fill_doubling_run_table_tail
description: Fills the remaining part of the same 512-entry table with alternating doubling runs, starting from the current index, until the table is complete.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:C596
name: allocate_zeroed_table_block
description: Allocates a block whose size is derived from the count argument, zeroes it, and points four table fields into it at fixed multiples of the count. It returns 1 when the allocation fails and 0 on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:C5BC
name: zero_and_set_table_pointers
description: Zeroes a block whose size is derived from the count argument, then points four table fields into it at the same multiples of the count. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:C5C8
name: fill_block_and_set_pointers
description: Fills a block with one byte value using a countdown loop, then sets four table pointers at multiples of the count within the block. It returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:C606
name: free_table_block_sized
description: Frees the table block when its pointer is set, using the size derived from the count argument, then clears its four table pointers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:C874
name: format_text_raw_do_fmt
description: Calls the exec library's RawDoFmt through the exec base to format text, with the output handled by a byte-copy routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:C898
name: format_text_raw_do_fmt
description: Calls the exec library's RawDoFmt through the exec base to format text, with the output handled by a byte-copy routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:C8BE
name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address held in the pointer register, then returns. Its address is taken elsewhere in the program, so it is probably used as an output callback.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:D544
name: compute_crc32_of_buffer
description: Updates a running reflected CRC-32 over a byte buffer using a 256-entry table in the decoder state, processing 16-byte groups before the remainder. It saves the running value in the state and returns the inverted CRC.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:D63E
name: update_crc_in_chunks
description: Resets the running CRC state to all ones and returns zero when the buffer pointer is null. Otherwise it passes the buffer to the CRC update in steps of 1048576 bytes and returns the result of the last update.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:D65A
name: walk_buffer_in_large_chunks
description: Steps through a length in 1048576-byte chunks, calling a helper for each full chunk and once more for the remainder. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:D66C
name: step_buffer_remainder_after_chunks
description: Calls a helper for each full 1048576-byte step, checks the remaining length after each step, and makes one final helper call for any leftover bytes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E420
name: build_huffman_decode_table
description: Builds a Huffman decode lookup table from an array of code lengths by counting each length, deriving the first code for every length, and filling table entries. For a width other than 12 it zeroes the table first, and for width 12 it copies a fixed pattern; the decompiled listing is truncated, so the later fill steps are not covered.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E6C0
name: run_handler_pointer_list
description: Walks a null-terminated table of handler pointers and calls the handler at each step while the flag allows it. It sets a completed flag and returns the result of the last call.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E6C6
name: dispatch_handler_table_entries
description: Calls the handler at each entry of a null-terminated pointer table, guarding repeat calls with a flag, and sets a completed flag at the end. It returns the last handler result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E6F4
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls the handler held in a global pointer with the address of a global variable, then returns the constant 20.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E716
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls the function pointer held in a global table with the address of a global variable as its argument. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E7D8
name: compare_case_insensitive_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings character by character after converting lowercase letters to uppercase, and returns the difference between the first mismatching characters, or zero when they are equal.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E81C
name: parse_signed_integer
description: Parses an optional plus or minus sign followed by decimal digits from a string, storing the signed value in the integer the second argument points to. It returns the offset of the first non-digit character after the number.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E868
name: lowercase_string_in_place
description: Walks a null-terminated string and adds 32 to each byte whose class-table flag marks it as an uppercase letter, converting it in place. It returns the string pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E874
name: lowercase_string_via_pointer
description: Converts uppercase letters to lowercase in a null-terminated string addressed by a pointer register, using the same class-table test, with no return value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E88E
name: lowercase_string_after_seed_byte
description: Writes a seed byte to the destination, then copies the characters that follow in the same string, lowercasing uppercase letters, until the terminator is reached.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E8A0
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Walks a null-terminated string and subtracts 32 from each byte whose class-table flag marks it as a lowercase letter, converting it in place to uppercase. It returns the string pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E8AC
name: uppercase_string_via_pointer
description: Converts lowercase letters to uppercase in a null-terminated string addressed by a pointer register, using the same class-table test, with no return value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E8C6
name: uppercase_string_after_seed_byte
description: Writes a seed byte to the destination, then copies the following characters from the same string, uppercasing lowercase letters, until the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E8D8
name: free_pending_list_nodes
description: Pops each entry off the pending list, updating the current-entry field, and frees it through the exec library. For the last entry it may first call another exec routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E8DE
name: drain_pending_list_entries
description: Pops and frees entries from the pending list in a do-while loop, updating the current-entry and status fields and calling an exec routine for the last one when a size threshold is met. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E948
name: run_exec_calls_saved_arg
description: Stores its argument in a stack slot, runs an optional callback and a helper, then calls several exec library routines in one of two branches before returning the stored value. The decompiled listing contains debug-style marker stores that are not part of the behaviour.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:E950
name: parse_command_line_into_argv
description: Splits a command line into words, treating double-quoted spans as single words and an asterisk followed by E or N as an escape or newline character. It allocates an array of word pointers through exec, stores it, then calls each entry of the callback list before returning.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EAB4
name: free_argv_array_if_set
description: Frees the argument array through the exec library when its count and pointer are both nonzero, and returns the count otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EAD8
name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares two byte strings for at most the given number of characters, returning zero when they match. On the first mismatch it returns minus one if the first string's byte is smaller and one if it is larger.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EAFC
name: map_condition_flags_to_sign
description: Reads the processor condition flags left by a previous comparison and returns minus one when the result is less or equal, otherwise one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EB08
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminating zero of the destination string and copies the source string, including its terminator, onto the end. It returns the original destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EB20
name: copy_string_limited_padded
description: Copies at most the given number of bytes from the source to the destination, stopping after the source terminator and padding the rest of the count with zero bytes. It returns the destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EB30
name: copy_string_and_zero_pad
description: Copies a zero-terminated source into the destination and then clears any remaining count bytes with zeros, using register arguments and returning nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EB3A
name: zero_fill_counted_block
description: Writes zero bytes starting at the destination address for the count in the data register plus one. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EB44
name: test_char_class_then_call
description: Returns zero for a null argument. For a non-null argument it tests the class-table flag of the first byte in a loop and calls a helper; the decompiled listing is partly garbled by overlapping instructions.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EB78
name: run_callback_list_then_helper
description: Walks the registered callback list and calls each entry, then passes its argument to a helper and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EB7C
name: run_callback_list_then_finish
description: Walks the registered callback list and calls each entry, then calls a helper with no arguments.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EBC6
name: drain_pending_list_until_limit
description: Saves the caller's arguments in a stack frame, then pops entries from the pending list and frees them through the exec library until the list is empty or reaches the saved stack position. It returns the saved argument pair.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[a][hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[a][HD].adf:lzx:0:EC50
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls a helper with no arguments and returns, doing nothing else.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0000
name: init_narrator_device_base
description: Creates the device base with MakeLibrary, allocates a message port with a signal bit and the owning task, then registers the device and its task with exec. It returns minus one on success and zero when the base cannot be created.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00D0
name: open_narrator_unit_request
description: Rejects a nonzero unit number with an error code, and for unit zero increments the open count and fills in the request when the unit is already open. Otherwise it opens the audio device and allocates the request block, setting an error code on failure.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00DE
name: open_audio_device_for_unit
description: When the unit is idle, opens the audio device and allocates a request block with default speech settings; when the unit is already open it increments the count and fills in the request. Failures set error codes on the request.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0110
name: allocate_narrator_request_block
description: Allocates a request block through exec and, on success, stores it, increments the open count and fills in the default speech settings. On allocation failure it sets the error code to 254.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:014E
name: store_unit_and_fill_defaults
description: Stores the given value in the unit structure, increments its counters, and writes default speech settings into the request: rate 150, pitch 110, volume 64 and a sampling value of 22200. It then clears a flag bit in the unit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01A0
name: finish_request_with_status
description: Stores a status byte in the request and sets its completion marker to minus one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01AE
name: queue_or_complete_device_request
description: With interrupts disabled, either completes the request immediately when its unit is idle or inserts it into the unit's pending list. Interrupts are re-enabled when the nesting count reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01E0
name: insert_request_into_unit_list
description: Inserts a request into one of the unit's queues with interrupts disabled. When the request belongs to the active unit and its status differs, it is updated and handed to a helper instead.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0222
name: complete_or_queue_unit_request
description: When the unit is not busy and the request's status differs, copies the unit's status into the request and calls a helper. Otherwise it inserts the request into the unit's queue with interrupts disabled.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:026A
name: copy_byte_and_split_nibbles
description: Copies a status byte from one structure to another, splits it into low and high nibbles stored in two bytes, clears the request's flag byte, and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0290
name: validate_speech_request_fields
description: Searches the request list for an entry belonging to the unit and checks its speech settings: rate from 1 to 400, pitch from 65 to 320, sampling value from 5000 to 28000, volume from 0 to 64, and two flags of 0 or 1. Valid values are copied into the unit state, and out-of-range values take a fallback path; the text is then scanned for word breaks at commas, dashes and spaces.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:02F2
name: validate_speech_params_after_search
description: Performs the same speech setting checks and copies as its neighbour, starting from the current request rather than searching the list. It then scans the text for word breaks in the same way.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:030C
name: release_unit_when_idle
description: Scans the request list for entries that belong to the unit and runs a helper on each match. It then decrements the unit's open count and, when the count reaches zero, frees the unit through exec and closes the device, calling an extra helper when a flag bit is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0332
name: decrement_counter_and_close
description: Decrements the unit's counter and, when it reaches zero, frees the unit through exec and closes the device, then calls an extra helper if a flag bit is set. Otherwise it does nothing else.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:036E
name: dispatch_narrator_command
description: Dispatches the request to one of eight command handlers, chosen by the request's command number from a table in the device. Numbers outside that range set error code 249 and call a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:038E
name: unlink_free_request_or_flag
description: If the request's counter is zero, unlinks it from its list, frees it and a second block through exec, and returns the value stored in the request's final field. Otherwise it sets a busy flag in the request and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03AE
name: unlink_free_and_return_field
description: Unlinks the request from its list, frees it and a second block through exec, and returns the value stored in the request's final field.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03F4
name: handle_narrator_command_switch
description: Handles a narrator request according to its type: types 6, 7, 8 and 1 set or clear device flags around library calls, and type 2 handles a speech request. Any other type either calls a library routine or completes with status 254, and the routine finishes by calling a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:046C
name: set_mode_seven_run_library
description: Clears a flag bit in the request, sets the unit's mode to seven with a pending flag, calls two library routines, clears the request status and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04A8
name: set_mode_six_run_library
description: Sets a flag bit in the request, sets the unit's mode to six with a pending flag, calls a library routine, clears the request status and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04E6
name: set_flag_clear_around_calls
description: Sets bit 7 in a byte of the request structure, calls two helpers, then clears the same bit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0510
name: set_flag_clear_status_call
description: Sets bit 7 in a byte of the first structure, calls a helper, clears that bit, sets the status byte of the second structure to zero, and calls another helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0540
name: scan_list_with_interrupts_disabled
description: Optionally runs a helper, then with interrupts disabled walks a list in the structure and runs a helper on each entry, re-enabling interrupts afterwards. It returns the result of the last helper call.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0570
name: decrement_counter_and_set_global
description: Decrements the interrupt nesting count in the global area and, if the previous value was less than one, writes the enable value to the interrupt control register.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0584
name: remove_request_from_list_disabled
description: Removes a request from the unit's list with interrupts disabled: if it is the current entry it is only marked busy, otherwise it is searched for and unlinked with status 254. Interrupts are re-enabled afterwards and a helper runs.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05B0
name: search_and_unlink_request
description: Searches a list for the request and, if found, unlinks it and sets its status to 254. It then decrements the interrupt nesting count and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05BE
name: unlink_known_request_status
description: Unlinks a request already known to be in its list, sets its status to 254, decrements the interrupt nesting count and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05E8
name: decrement_nesting_and_enable
description: Decrements the interrupt nesting count and re-enables interrupts when the previous value was less than one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0600
name: complete_request_with_status_249
description: Sets the request's status byte to 249 and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:060C
name: clear_request_status_and_call
description: Clears the request's status byte to zero and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0616
name: clear_flags_and_call_handler
description: Clears a flag bit in one structure, clears a byte in another, and calls a handler through the library base.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0710
name: validate_speech_params_and_split
description: Checks the speech settings in the request against the rate, pitch, sampling, volume and flag ranges, copying valid values into the unit state, then scans the text for word breaks. Out-of-range settings take a fallback path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0744
name: validate_speech_rate_and_copy
description: Stores the rate from the data register into the unit state when it is below 401, then validates pitch, two flags, sampling value and volume and copies them. It scans the text for word breaks, and out-of-range values take a fallback path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:075E
name: validate_speech_pitch_and_copy
description: Stores the pitch from the data register when it is below 321, then validates the two flags, sampling value and volume and copies them. It then scans the text for word breaks.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:077E
name: store_speech_mode_then_validate
description: Stores the first flag from the data register into the unit state, then validates the second flag, sampling value and volume before copying them. It scans the text for word breaks afterwards.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0798
name: store_speech_flag_then_validate
description: Stores the second flag from the data register, then validates the sampling value and volume before copying them. It scans the text for word breaks afterwards.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07AC
name: validate_speech_sampling_and_copy
description: Stores the sampling value from the data register when it is below 28001, then validates the volume, copies the speech values and scans the text for word breaks. Out-of-range values take a fallback path.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07C6
name: store_speech_volume_and_scan
description: Stores the volume from the data register when it is 64 or less, then copies the speech values and scans the text for word breaks. A larger volume completes the request with its status instead.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0846
name: set_task_priority_free_buffer
description: Changes the task priority through exec around a find-task lookup, frees a buffer through exec when a flag is set, and completes the request with its status when a trailing value is nonzero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08E6
name: copy_counter_and_set_status
description: Copies a counter from the request into the unit's counter field, stores the status byte and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08EE
name: clear_counter_and_set_status
description: Clears the request's counter field, stores the status byte and calls a helper.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0900
name: continue_text_break_scan
description: Continues the backward scan for a comma, dash or space break point in the speech text, records the break position, and then either finishes the request or moves on to the next segment.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0930
name: scan_text_for_space_break
description: Looks backwards through the speech text for a space to use as the break point, records it in the unit state, and then either finishes the request or continues the segment chain.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0956
name: record_text_break_position
description: Records the length-based break position in the unit state, then scans the text for a break point and either continues the segment chain or finishes the request.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0CF0
name: initialise_speech_port_and_table
description: Clears several unit fields, opens a library through the DOS base, allocates a message port through exec, and copies a fixed table of 34 words into a buffer. It returns zero on success, 250 when no handler exists for the speech mode, or 254 when an allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D46
name: allocate_speech_port_and_table
description: Allocates a message port through exec, stores its pointer, and copies a fixed table into a newly allocated buffer for the speech mode. It returns zero on success, 250 when no handler exists for that mode, or 254 when the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D68
name: create_speech_iorb_and_table
description: Stores a supplied port in the unit, allocates a signal and task pair for it through exec, and copies a 34-word table for the speech mode into a new buffer. It returns zero on success, 250 when no handler exists for the mode, or 254 when an allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DBE
name: allocate_speech_table_buffer
description: Stores the speech mode byte, allocates a buffer through exec, and copies a 34-word table from the unit into it. It returns 254 when the allocation fails and zero otherwise.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DDE
name: copy_word_table_to_buffer
description: Stores the buffer pointer in the unit, then copies a 34-word table from the unit into the buffer, writing each word to two places per iteration for a count taken from a mode byte. It returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E14
name: free_speech_buffers_set_mode
description: Sets the unit's mode to nine, sends a request through DoIO, and frees the table buffer and port resources through exec when their pointers are set. It clears a counter field and returns a result with its low bit set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E24
name: send_io_and_free_resources
description: Sets the unit's mode to nine and sends the request with DoIO through exec, then frees the table buffer and signal through FreeMem and FreeSignal when their pointers are set. It clears a counter field and returns a combined result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F68
name: tokenize_phoneme_text
description: Walks the speech text matching one- or two-character symbols against a 112-entry phoneme table in the device, recording each matched symbol and its attribute bytes in three arrays in the unit state. It returns the matched value and the text position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F72
name: scan_phoneme_text_unchecked
description: Initialises the three phoneme attribute arrays in the unit state and scans the speech text for phoneme symbols against the 112-entry table, without the early exit a zero-length check would give. It returns the matched value and text position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FE4
name: continue_phoneme_scan_at_match
description: Continues the phoneme scan after a symbol has matched, recording the symbol and applying its attribute bits, then advances through the text until a terminator or a limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FF8
name: continue_phoneme_scan_limited
description: Continues the phoneme scan from the current position and stops early when the text pointer reaches the recorded limit, recording matched symbols the same way as its neighbours.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1026
name: continue_phoneme_scan_at_symbol
description: Records the current symbol and its attribute bits, then keeps scanning the text for further phoneme symbols until a terminator or the table limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1064
name: apply_phoneme_attribute_and_scan
description: Applies a stress or attribute bit to the most recent phoneme entry, then continues scanning the text for phoneme symbols until a terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1074
name: mark_phoneme_flag_and_scan
description: Sets bit 4 in the attribute byte of the most recent phoneme entry when the symbol is the sixth type, then continues scanning the phoneme text until a terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1084
name: store_phoneme_symbol_and_scan
description: Stores the current symbol in the phoneme list at the current index, advances the index, and continues scanning the text until a terminator or the buffer limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10AA
name: scan_phoneme_text_from_position
description: Checks the remaining text against the recorded limit, then matches the next phoneme symbol against the table and keeps recording symbols until a terminator or the buffer limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10C2
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10CC
name: terminate_phoneme_arrays
description: Writes end markers into the three phoneme attribute arrays at the current index, stores the scanned length in the unit state, and returns the matched value and text position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10D8
name: pad_and_terminate_phoneme_list
description: Pads the phoneme list with a default entry when an attribute check passes, writes end markers into the three arrays, and records the scanned length.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1122
name: record_phoneme_count
description: Stores the phoneme count from the data register into the unit state.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:112C
name: mark_stressed_phoneme_neighbours
description: Walks the phoneme list and, for each symbol whose class-table flags mark it as stressed, sets the flag bit on the one or two entries before it. The pass stops at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:118E
name: mark_stress_neighbours_loop
description: Performs the same neighbour-flag pass over the phoneme list as its neighbour, returning at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:119E
name: mark_stress_neighbours_from_index
description: Applies the neighbour-flag pass to the phoneme list starting from the index in the data register, and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:11BC
name: apply_phoneme_flag_rules
description: Walks the phoneme list and applies per-symbol rules, setting bit 7 on the symbols it handles and propagating attribute bits to the entries of the preceding symbol. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:121A
name: propagate_phoneme_attribute_bits
description: Continues the phoneme rule pass by copying the attribute bits of the preceding symbol onto the current entries and marking group flags, until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1262
name: apply_phoneme_group_flags
description: Continues the phoneme rule pass for the next symbol group, setting group flags on the entries it covers until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12CC
name: continue_phoneme_rule_pass
description: Continues the phoneme rule pass from the current group, setting attribute bits on the entries it covers until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D6
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D8
name: match_phoneme_rule_pattern
description: Scans a table of phoneme rules, matching the three characters at the current position against each rule's pattern where 255 acts as a wildcard. When a rule matches it applies the replacement bytes and calls helpers, and it returns when the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1324
name: continue_phoneme_rule_match
description: Continues the phoneme rule-table matching by testing the next pattern's characters against the text, and applies replacement bytes on a full match, until the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13C2
name: advance_phoneme_rule_match
description: Advances to the next table rule and tests its pattern against the text, applying replacement bytes when every character matches, until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13D6
name: scan_phoneme_rule_table_step
description: Steps through the phoneme rule table and applies the rule whose pattern matches at the current position, returning when the end marker is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13E4
name: test_bit_with_table_lookup
description: Repeatedly looks up a word in a table indexed by a value, adjusts it according to bit flags in a byte of the input, and stops when the chosen bit is set in the result. It also returns when the byte's top bit is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1412
name: insert_phoneme_entry_bounded
description: When the phoneme count is below 512, increments the count and shifts the three phoneme arrays up by one entry from the current position. It then writes a byte at the insertion point and zeroes the new entries in the other two arrays.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1428
name: shift_bytes_and_clear_fields
description: Increments the phoneme count, shifts the three arrays up by one entry from the computed position, then writes a byte from a register and two zero bytes at the new ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1454
name: call_seven_helpers_return_zero
description: Calls seven helpers in sequence and returns zero.
